# MDL601 · `connection-keys-ignored`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

`host`, `user` or `password` in a group where nobody reads them.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | connection |
| Default severity | error |
| Fix | unsafe |
| Design references | F3, F13, C1 |
| Proven on real mydumper by | [`mdl601-connection-keys-in-tool-group-ignored`](../../e2e/scenarios/mdl601-connection-keys-in-tool-group-ignored.txtar), [`mdl601-control-connection-keys-without-client-group`](../../e2e/scenarios/mdl601-control-connection-keys-without-client-group.txtar) |

## Why

mydumper does not pass `host`, `user` and `password` to its option parser: the MySQL client library reads them. It reads [mydumper] only while the file has no [client] section: once [client] exists, mydumper tells the library to read the [client] family of groups only, and the connection keys of [mydumper] are read by nobody. Keys in per-product groups ([mydumper_mysql]) are never read. The fix moves them to [client], unless [client] already sets them.

## Example

❌ Before:

```ini
[client]
host=db

[mydumper]
user=backup
host=other
threads=4
[mydumper_mysql]
password=x
```

```text
5:1-5:5 error MDL601[connection-keys-ignored] `user` in [mydumper] is read by nobody: mydumper leaves connection keys to the MySQL client library, and the file has a [client] section, so the MySQL client library reads [client], not [mydumper]
  = The connection does not use this user: it falls back to [client], the command line or the defaults.
  fix (unsafe): Move it to [client]
6:1-6:5 error MDL601[connection-keys-ignored] `host` in [mydumper] is read by nobody: mydumper leaves connection keys to the MySQL client library, and the file has a [client] section, so the MySQL client library reads [client], not [mydumper]
  = The connection does not use this host: it falls back to [client], the command line or the defaults.
9:1-9:9 error MDL601[connection-keys-ignored] `password` in [mydumper_mysql] is read by nobody: mydumper leaves connection keys to the MySQL client library, and the MySQL client library never reads [mydumper_mysql]
  = The connection does not use this password: it falls back to [client], the command line or the defaults.
  fix (unsafe): Move it to [client]
```

✅ After `mydumper-lint check --fix --unsafe-fixes`:

```ini
[client]
host=db
user=backup
password=x

[mydumper]
host=other
threads=4
[mydumper_mysql]
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL601: warning   # or error, info, off
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL601` on the line above it.
